## Architecture Gate ([declaration](../docs/DECLARATION.ru.md))

- [ ] Read the normative declaration and identified the real application problem.
- [ ] Before/after example or measurable infrastructure improvement included.
- [ ] No unnecessary duplication of schema or manual coordination; explicit exceptions explained.
- [ ] Deterministic semantics, security, integrity and relevant negative tests reviewed.
- [ ] Implemented behavior, limitations and evidence documented.

## Tests performed

- [ ] No secrets or unauthorized third-party code
